department: Department of Computer Science (Howard R. Hughes College of Engineering)

deadline.value: International applicants on an F-1 visa must apply by May 1 for fall; the department's own date is August 1.
deadline.quote: All application materials must be submitted to the Graduate College through the Application Portal by May 1 (fall semester)

gre_general.value: The department requires an official GRE General score of at least 315.
gre_general.quote: A minimum score of 315 on the general test of the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is required.

gre_subject.value: Computer science has no GRE subject test, and the department page does not mention one.

supervisor.value: The department admissions page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The department admissions page does not describe PhD funding.

entry_route.value: A master's in computer science is expected; direct PhD entry is rare.
entry_route.quote: Students are expected to have a master’s degree in computer science before applying to the Ph.D. program.

also.quote: A GPA of 3.70 (on a 4.00 scale) or higher in post-baccalaureate course work is required for admission.

notes: Department page: GPA 3.70 or higher in post-baccalaureate work, and three letters. The Dec 2024 table also lists the GRE as required. Department's own deadline: August 1 (Dec 1 for spring), per the Graduate College table; the earlier international date (May 1) is the one saved.
